claims.claim: The first Cybercab used cathode material produced at Tesla's new plant in the Americas.
claims.episode_span: The first Cybercab rolled off the line using cathode active material produced at Tesla's new plant in the Americas.
claims.source_title: Cybercab Milestone: First Made with In-House Cathode from Americas Plant
claims.supporting_quote: First Cybercab made using our in-house cathode material – from the first cathode plant in the Americas

claims.claim: Tesla added ten Model Y vehicles bringing the Texas Robotaxi fleet to 420 Model Y units plus 69 Cybercabs.
claims.episode_span: Tesla added ten Model Y vehicles to its Texas Robotaxi fleet. The total now stands at 420 Model Y units plus 69 Cybercabs.
claims.source_title: Tesla expands Texas Robotaxi fleet to 489 vehicles
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla just expanded its Texas Robotaxi fleet by 10 Model Ys, bringing the total to (you guessed it) 420 vehicles Factor in 69 Cybercabs, and the fleet now tops out at 489

claims.claim: Images labeled gen3 appeared inside the Tesla Android app installation package on September 23.
claims.episode_span: Images labeled "gen3" appeared inside the Tesla Android app installation package. The robot shows a gold and black color scheme with added hip and leg coverings.
claims.supporting_quote: On September 23, media outlets including Tesla North and Drive Tesla reported that a set of robot images marked with "gen3" appeared in the installation package of Tesla's Android app.

claims.claim: Sunrun and Tesla reported a record 580 MW of home battery dispatch in California.
claims.episode_span: Sunrun and Tesla reported a record 580 MW of home battery dispatch in California. The dispatch came from aggregated Powerwall systems.
claims.source_title: Sunrun, Tesla tout record 580 MW home battery dispatch in California
claims.supporting_quote: Sunrun, Tesla tout record 580 MW home battery dispatch in California

claims.claim: The accordion-style Supercharger uses a single truck platform that can telescope to support higher stall counts.
claims.episode_span: The new Supercharger station features an accordion-style expandable design. The station supports higher stall counts on a single truck platform.
claims.source_title: Tesla’s “Accordion” Supercharger Station Goes Live as BYD Accelerates Its Pursuit
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla’s “Accordion” Supercharger Station Goes Live as BYD Accelerates Its Pursuit
